## HARPS

- Resolving power: 120,000
- Native step: 0.609334 km/s per pixel
- Notes: R and the native step follow the ESO instrument description: R_S = 120,000 (measured) and 4.1 px per FWHM, i.e. ~0.609 km/s per detector pixel. The ESO overview page and the ADP SPEC_RES header quote the nominal R = 115,000. Recommended settings are the project's empirical defaults (examples/04_template_from_data_tiravel.ipynb), not instrument documentation.
- References: <https://www.eso.org/sci/facilities/lasilla/instruments/harps/inst/description.html>, <https://www.eso.org/sci/facilities/lasilla/instruments/harps/overview.html>, <https://www.eso.org/sci/observing/phase3/p3sdpstd.pdf>

### `HARPS`

ESO Phase-3 SDP 1-D spectrum (ADP.*.fits, HARPS DRS s1d): one-row binary table in HDU1 with WAVE / FLUX / ERR columns.

- Loader: `sparta.instruments.harps.load_sdp`
- Grid: linear, 0.01 Angstrom per pixel (SPEC_BIN = 0.001 nm) (resampled by the archive pipeline)
- Orders returned: one
- Wavelength frame: air; SPECSYS: BARYCENT; time: BJD (HARPS DRS; scale unverified)
- Recommended CCF step: 0.1 km/s
- Recommended window: 4990–5090 Å
- Recommended preprocessing: `preprocess(n_trim=10, clean_margins=True, remove_nans=True, delta=0.5, cosmic_sigma=3, filter_lowcut=3, filter_highcut=0.15, alpha=0.3)`

### `HARPS-CERES` (unverified)

HARPS spectrum reduced with the CERES pipeline: a cube whose data[0] / data[3] hold the per-order wavelength / blaze-corrected flux; the order that best covers the window is returned.

- Loader: `sparta.instruments.harps.load_ceres`
- Grid: native echelle pixels (one order)
- Orders returned: one
- Wavelength frame: vacuum; SPECSYS: BARYCENT; time: MBJD-UTC
- Recommended settings: none yet

## NRES

- Resolving power: 53,000
- Native step: 1.45 km/s per pixel
- Notes: LCO quotes R ~ 53,000 in its summary and a 'typical spectral resolution of 48,000' (4.47 pixels per fiber width) in the optical-design section. native_step_kms is measured, not documented: the median c * dlambda / lambda of the bundled TOI677 e91 files (1.44-1.52 km/s over the 67 orders). Recommended settings are the project's empirical defaults (examples/02_radial_velocity_unicor.ipynb), not instrument documentation.
- References: <https://lco.global/observatory/instruments/nres/>, <https://banzai-nres.readthedocs.io>

### `NRES`

NRES commissioning (IDL) pipeline extracted spectrum, RLEVEL 91 ('*-e91.fits'): HDU2 SPECFLAT flux and HDU6 WAVESPEC wavelengths (nm), 67 orders x 4096 pixels.

- Loader: `sparta.instruments.nres.load_e91`
- Grid: native echelle pixels
- Orders returned: all
- Wavelength frame: —; SPECSYS: TOPOCENT; time: BJD-TDB
- Recommended CCF step: 0.05 km/s
- Recommended preprocessing: `preprocess(n_trim=100, clean_margins=True, remove_nans=True, delta=0.5, cosmic_sigma=3, filter_lowcut=4, filter_highcut=0.15, alpha=0.3)`
- Orders to drop: 0–9, 50–66

### `NRES-BANZAI` (unverified)

BANZAI-NRES 1-D product: HDU1 table, one row per (fiber, order) with 'wavelength' (Angstrom) and 'normflux' columns; the SCIFIBER rows are read.

- Loader: `sparta.instruments.nres.load_banzai`
- Grid: native echelle pixels
- Orders returned: all
- Wavelength frame: vacuum; SPECSYS: TOPOCENT; time: BJD-TDB
- Recommended settings: none yet

## Simulated

- Resolving power: —
- Native step: —
- Notes: Resolving power, native step, wavelength frame and SPECSYS are those of the product named by Simulation(like=...).

### `SIMULATED` (simulated)

Spectra simulated at known radial velocities (PHOENIX or user templates, broadened, Doppler-shifted, noise added) as the `like` product would record them; use Observations(survey='SIMULATED', simulation=Simulation(...)). The injected values are on obs.truth.

- Loader: `sparta.instruments.simulated.simulate`
- Grid: log-lambda at the like instrument's native step (pixel centres), or the like product's archive grid with as_product=True
- Orders returned: all
- Wavelength frame: —; SPECSYS: —; time: days (simulated)
- Recommended settings: none yet
